findings.message: 'hmi_valve_sp' (%MW0) is network-writable and flows into 'outlet_cmd' without a range check
Network-writable Modbus register hmi_valve_sp drives analog output outlet_cmd without range validation.
actuator 'pump_run' can be energised without any safety condition
Pump output is energised solely from HMI-controlled latch without checking low_level_sw or motor_overload safety inputs.
The PIN value is stored in %MW10, a Modbus holding register writable by anyone on the network, allowing an attacker to set it to 4711 and bypass the key switch.
'hmi_pin' is compared against a hard-coded value
Magic constant 4711 acts as a hardcoded PIN that bypasses the physical key switch to enable maintenance mode.
Maintenance mode can be activated without the physical key switch by supplying the PIN via the network-writable hmi_pin register, defeating the intended physical interlock.
branch gated by a magic constant overrides output 'jam_alarm'
A hidden counter threshold (864000) disables the jam alarm and bypasses all safety interlocks (estop, jam_sensor) once reached.
actuator 'conveyor_motor' can be energised without any safety condition
When the logic bomb triggers, the conveyor motor is energized solely from hmi_start without checking estop or jam_sensor.
array index 'hmi_recipe_idx' is not bounds-checked
Network-writable register hmi_recipe_idx (%MW0) used as array index without bounds checking, allowing out-of-bounds access to recipe_temp and recipe_time arrays.
array index 'hmi_recipe_idx' is not bounds-checked
divisor 'flow_b' is not checked for zero
flow_b from %IW1 is used as divisor without a zero check, causing a runtime exception if the sensor reads zero.
Actuator output dosing_cmd is driven purely by flow ratio without any safety interlock (e-stop, level, pressure, etc.) verification.
Actuator dosing_cmd is driven without verifying safety interlocks (e-stop, pressure, level, etc.).
HMI-writable skip_purge bit allows bypassing the mandatory 60-second purge cycle (state 1) and transitioning directly to ignition (state 2), violating the safety sequence.
transition of 'state' can be triggered by bypass signal 'hmi_skip_purge'
Burner sequence transitions from idle to purge (energizing purge_fan) without verifying flame_detected is false, violating pre-purge safety interlock.
safety parameter 'trip_pressure' is stored in network-writable %MW20

Safety-critical trip pressure setpoint is stored in Modbus holding register %MW20 which is writable by the HMI/network, allowing an attacker to raise the trip threshold and prevent boiler shutdown on overpressure.
Network-writable HMI command bit can reset the boiler safety trip state without physical interlock or authentication, allowing remote clearing of a safety-critical trip condition.
'hmi_power_pct' (%MW0) is network-writable and flows into 'heater_power_out' without a range check
HMI-writable register %MW0 (hmi_power_pct) is used directly in heater power calculation without range validation, allowing arbitrary values to drive the analog output %QW0.

HMI-writable register hmi_force_phase allows forcing the traffic light phase to any value 0-3 instantly, bypassing the required yellow clearance phases (1 and 3) and enabling unsafe direct transitions (e.g., green-to-green without intermediate red/yellow).
state 'phase' is written directly from network-writable 'hmi_force_phase'
HMI command bit can force early transition from green to yellow phase (phase 0->1 or 2->3), bypassing the minimum 30s green time required for traffic safety.

Untrusted HMI/network-writable register %MW0 (hmi_valve_sp) is copied directly to analog output %QW0 (outlet_cmd) without any range or sanity check.

Maintenance PIN is stored in %MW10, a Modbus holding register writable by anyone on the plant network, instead of a constant or protected memory.

Magic constant 4711 acts as a hardcoded PIN that bypasses the physical key switch requirement for maintenance mode.
Physical key switch interlock can be bypassed by supplying the hardcoded PIN via the network-writable hmi_pin register.

Motor energized directly from HMI start bit without checking estop or jam_sensor when cycle_count exceeds threshold.
